title: Suno Prompt Engineering Guide with Co-existing Style Data
reported_observation: Repository advertises raw co-existing-style and default-style data files, plus community observations and prompting notes.
creator_interpretation: The repository encourages submissions with generation counts, time periods and corroboration.
our_hypothesis: Potentially valuable for building a genre association graph; dataset origin, collection method and redistribution license require audit.
limitations: Search-result-level capture; full content and linked media not independently audited.
Community claim is not evidence of Suno's private architecture.
Rights, terms, license and data provenance require review.
rights_and_terms: Not assessed. Link to original; do not redistribute code, datasets, audio or full post without permission/compatible license.
access_notes: Public web source. Metadata and summarized observations only.
